description: This header file defines API functions and overloads for marshalling and unmarshalling various fundamental and Abseil-specific types for command-line flag support, including support for optional types and custom user-defined types via ADL.

methods.name: ParseFlag
methods.description: Template function to parse a string into a flag value of type T, invoking internal parsing functions.

methods.name: UnparseFlag
methods.description: Template function to convert a flag value of type T into its string representation.
